campaign: v352 same-PDF paired text and formula regression — 50 real PDFs
provenance: all input PDFs were accessible original bytes in local corpus, 50 unique SHA-256; many appeared in preceding campaigns; not 50 newly sourced papers
audited_code: mathreader/js/41-equations-bibliography.js and mathreader/js/10-formula-ocr.js from v352; imported functions tested as-is; no application-code changes

method.native: all 1,125 PDF pages traversed by PyMuPDF; native text character count and page-level mathematical-glyph presence only
method.text_index: actual v352 detectedStructureResult, structureResultsIndexNavigationPage, equationLabelCandidatesInLine, bibliographyHeadingText invoked in Node VM on 1st, midpoint, last, and any pre-verified formula reference pages; only preliminary raw candidates, not full Equation index
method.formula: for every source PDF, choose an original page/formula-region (sometimes fallback page for negative controls), render it, and run English Tesseract CLI OCR proxy; preserve page/crop geometry and transcript. Tesseract does NOT generate Texify LaTeX
method.latex_compilation: 18 manually checked original-PDF LaTeX formulas in seven matched source files from formula_syntax_v352.json; fresh 228-case MathJax v352 compilation gate, not image-model inference
method.ground_truth: no exhaustive whole-document independent item inventory; do not classify fully verified PASS

limits: Only source-level preview of 3–4 pages per PDF for Result/Equation/Bibliography parser. Not full final indexes, Structure inference, recovery, navigation or browser PDF.js.
OCR proxy samples one region/page per document (50 calls); 51 pages of source corpus have <30 native chars, but full-page OCR of every such page was NOT performed.
No local Texify model and no production browser Formula OCR. Source-verified LaTeX compilation is NOT recognition accuracy.
Formula clip can be a page fallback or OCR-transcribed mathematical prose. Its absence of TeX cannot be interpreted as missing MathReader formula.
Existing known unresolved cases for Gromov, Pisier, Ahlfors, Simon, Caffarelli and handwriting retain earlier FAIL/UNVERIFIED states; the new campaign does not supersede or close them.
Old technical handwritten physics/engineering/geology remain missing as independently sourced documents.
